programmes.title: Core Kyoto
programmes.description: Core Kyoto.

programmes.title: NEWSROOM TOKYO
programmes.description: NEWSROOM TOKYO dives deeper into the day's news with insight and analysis, from the perspective of Japan and the rest of Asia. We put a spotlight on what you need to know to understand the issues.

programmes.title: Direct Talk #279
programmes.description: Yagisawa Satoshi's novel, "Days at the Morisaki Bookshop," has been translated into 50 languages. He talks about the inspiration behind a heartwarming story that captivated readers around the globe.

programmes.title: JAPAN FROM ABOVE: UP CLOSE
programmes.description: This program takes you on an aerial journey across 21st century Japan. Enjoy the bird's-eye view of unique landscapes as well as intimate portraits of the people who inhabit the archipelago.

programmes.title: One in Every Japanese
programmes.description: 1 in 50 families have lost a child during pregnancy or soon after birth. A couple who lost their second son when two hours old talks about their grief and sorrow, a topic often not discussed in Japan.

programmes.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
programmes.description: On those hot, humid summer nights, nothing can get in the way of sleep like mosquitoes on the hunt. We learn about the tools the Edo townspeople had at their disposal to fight the pesky insects.

programmes.title: Hometown Stories
